goal.text: Deliver the tracked release safely across its target projects

tasks.task:
## What
Design the release and record its API and rollout contract in docs/design.md.

## Why
Give implementers and approvers one stable contract so the release can proceed without incompatible assumptions.

## Acceptance criteria
- The API and rollout contract is complete.
- The design is verified against the current project.

## What
Record that the readiness handoff expects no repository change or separate review evidence.

## Why
Make the no-change boundary explicit so the release does not spend provider time on an unnecessary dispatch.

## Acceptance criteria
- The handoff records the no-change expectation.
Approve the API and rollout contract in docs/design.md.

steps.task:
## What
Implement the approved API and rollout behavior.

## Why
Deliver the approved release behavior to service users without breaking the agreed contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- The approved API and rollout behavior are implemented.
- Realistic request tests prove the contract.
steps.done_when: all task acceptance criteria are met, the approved contract is proven through real requests, and the repository's full gate passes

steps.task: Exercise the staged service and approve continuation on this branch.

## What
Run the full acceptance journey after staging approval and close every verified gap.

## Why
Prevent user-visible release regressions from surviving the staged approval boundary.

## Acceptance criteria
- The full acceptance journey passes.
- Every verified gap is fixed and covered.

tasks.task:
## What
Document the approved API and rollout.

## Why
Enable users to adopt the release confidently with accurate operating instructions.

## Acceptance criteria
- The approved API and rollout are documented.
- Every command is verified against the implementation.
Approve publication after reviewing the service and documentation results.

## What
Prepare the final release announcement from the verified implementation and documentation.

## Why
Give users a concise, trustworthy explanation of the release and its impact.

## Acceptance criteria
- The announcement matches the verified behavior and documentation.
- It clearly states the user impact.
